lumiata.note: healthcare predictive analytics; no financing trace after the 2017 filing

lyrical-foods-kite-hill.note: Lyrical Foods, the maker of Kite Hill almond-milk dairy; General Mills' 301 Inc took a stake and the brand was later sold on. The firm's own invest year 2011 is the founding year.

mach-industries.note: defence manufacturing, incorporated 2022; the only filing is a 2025 $102.0M round and Khosla's listing is recent, so the entry is at scale rather than at the founding. Recent frontier row with a large round and no cited valuation — queued for the A/B pass.

mainspring-energy.note: linear generators; founded 2010 as Etagen and renamed Mainspring in 2020, and the firm's own invest year is 2010, so Khosla entered at the founding round. The etagen row is the same company — flagged for identity-merges.json. No priced event above $1B with a citable figure.

mariana-minerals.note: critical-minerals extraction; on the live Sustainability surface only

mascoma.note: consolidated bioprocessing for cellulosic ethanol; the yeast business was acquired by Lallemand in 2014 after the IPO was withdrawn

mazama.note: on the live Sustainability surface only, so a recent entry

mdalgorithms-inc.note: MDalgorithms, the Mdacne acne-treatment app; the firm's own invest year is 2017

medisas.note: hospital-records software; no trace after the 2016 filing

meebo.note: acq. by Google, 2012, ~$100M — browser-based instant messaging and the Meebo Bar

memsql.note: MemSQL renamed SingleStore in 2020; Nikita Shamgunov co-founded it and later joined Khosla as a partner, which is the D3 founder-operator pattern in the direction that is still a real position. Reported around $1.3B in 2022 — queued for the A/B pass to pin or kill.

metamind.note: acq. by Salesforce, 2016 — Richard Socher's deep-learning startup, which became Salesforce Einstein

misfit-wearables.note: acq. by Fossil Group, 2015, $260M — the Shine activity tracker. The firm's own invest year 2012 is the founding year.

miso.note: Miso, the social TV check-in app on the 2012-2013 chart; wound down. Not Miso Robotics, which is a different company.

moka5.note: MokaFive, desktop virtualisation; wound down 2015 with the assets sold

mokafive.note: the moka5 row is the same company under the chart-era spelling — flagged for identity-merges.json

momentum-machines.note: the burger robot; renamed Creator and the restaurant closed for good in 2023. The creator row is the same company — flagged for identity-merges.json.

monumental.note: bricklaying robots, Amsterdam; on the live Frontier surface

moonwalk-biosciences.note: epigenetic mapping and writing; on the live Therapeutics surface

mtailor.note: custom clothing measured by phone camera, YC-backed

nanoh2o.note: acq. by LG Chem, 2014, ~$200M — reverse-osmosis membranes

natron-energy.note: sodium-ion batteries; wound down in 2025 after failing to raise for the Michigan plant. The firm's own invest year 2013 against a 2012 founding puts the entry at the seed.

neurotrack-technologies-inc.note: cognitive-health assessment; ~$50M raised across five rounds

nirvanix.note: cloud storage; shut down abruptly in Sep 2013 giving customers two weeks to migrate

nitricity.note: electrified nitrogen fertiliser; still filing as of 2025

nutanix.note: the company's own press release: Khosla Ventures led the $25M Series B in 2011. Series B and later is Growth by taxonomy; the firm's own card says 'Early', which the gate refused.

okta.note: Khosla (David Weiden) entered at the 2011 Series B, not the 2009 Series A which Andreessen Horowitz led. Series B is Growth by taxonomy.

oneid.note: identity/authentication spin-out of Confident Technologies; no trace after the 2012 filings

openai.note: Khosla led a $50M investment in January 2019, the first venture capital into OpenAI. No round name exists, so the label follows the scale: an unnamed $50M entry into a three-year-old lab is an entry at scale, Growth by taxonomy. The firm's own card says 'Early'.

opendoor-technologies-inc.note: Keith Rabois co-founded Opendoor in 2014 while a Khosla partner and the firm's own invest year is 2014, so the entry is the founding round. DISPUTE: the recorded valuation is a 2025-06-30 SEC float of $0.34B, which three other landed bases contradict at roughly $3.97B as of 2026-08 — the float is stale and the market cap must be re-pinned in the A/B pass.

opentrons.note: lab robotics; founded 2014, the firm's own invest year is 2016. The Form D address is Brooklyn, recorded as New York per the municipality rule.

oscar.note: Oscar Health, NYSE: OSCR. Founded 2012, the firm's own invest year is 2013; Khosla was in the early rounds but the round name is not established.

overture-life.note: IVF automation; incorporated 2017 with the first filing the same year

panzura.note: hybrid cloud file services; recapitalised by Profile Capital in 2020 and still operating

plastiq.note: Chapter 11 in May 2023 and the business sold to Priority Technology out of it — acquired with a successor, not defunct (COLLECTION.md §6, the insolvency-then-sale rule)

pvt-solar-inc.note: solar thermal-electric hybrid; no trace after the 2010 filing

pymetrics.note: acq. by Harver, 2022 — neuroscience-based hiring assessment

quantopian.note: wound down Nov 2020 and the team went to Robinhood; recorded acquired as an acquihire per COLLECTION.md §6

quantumscape.note: solid-state batteries, spun out of Stanford in 2010; the firm's own invest year is 2010, so the entry is the founding round. The firm's own card also says Seed.

rad-ai.note: radiology report generation; the firm's first filing is the 2024 $72.9M round, well after the 2018 founding

ramp.note: Ramp's 2019 seed was led by Keith Rabois at FOUNDERS FUND, not at Khosla — he was there 2019-2024 and the seat dates against the person's firm at filing time (T4). Khosla's own site lists Ramp and the firm's Form D span starts 2020, so the entry is a later round; the round name is not established.

realta-fusion.note: magnetic-mirror fusion out of UW-Madison, incorporated 2022; the 2025 $35.5M round is the firm's first filing

redoxblox.note: thermochemical energy storage, incorporated 2020; the Form D address is a Michigan co-founder's, the company operates from San Diego

rightway-healthcare.note: pharmacy benefits and care navigation; the 2024 $108.7M round is the firm's only filing. Large recent round with no cited valuation — queued for the A/B pass.

rocket-lab.note: Khosla in Rocket Lab's 2013 Series A. The firm's own card says 'Seed', which over-reads a documented Series A — one of the gate's fifteen scored rows.

roofstock.note: single-family rental marketplace; reported around $1.9B in the 2022 Series E, now stale. Queued for the A/B pass to pin or kill.

rubrik.note: founded 2014; Lightspeed led the Series A in 2015 and Greylock the Series B in 2016. The firm's own invest year is 2016, so Khosla entered at the Series B or later — Growth by taxonomy.

seamicro.note: DISPUTE: recorded defunct, but SeaMicro was acquired by AMD in Feb 2012 for ~$334M and only discontinued as an AMD product line in 2015. The exit event is an acquisition and that is what the track record reads; the shutdown is the acquirer's decision about a product, not the company's outcome.

seeo.note: acq. by Bosch, 2015 — solid-state lithium batteries out of Berkeley Lab

segetis.note: acq. by GFBiochemicals, 2016 — bio-based levulinic ketals

shoes-of-prey.note: custom shoes; entered administration and ceased trading in 2019. Ben Ling's Form D here is dated 2015, inside his Khosla tenure — this is Khosla's deal, not a Bling Capital one (calibration gate key correction).

silicium-energy.note: renamed Matrix Industries, thermoelectric wearables; no trace after the 2016 filings

skybox-imaging.note: acq. by Google, 2014, $500M; became Terra Bella and was sold on to Planet Labs in 2017

soladigm.note: Soladigm renamed View Inc in 2012; View went public by SPAC in 2021, filed Chapter 11 in 2024 and was bought by Cantor Fitzgerald out of it. The view-glass row is the same company — flagged for identity-merges.json.

solum.note: acq. by Monsanto, 2014 — soil nitrate testing

spatial-photonics.note: micromirror display devices; no trace after the 2010 filings

stion.note: CIGS thin-film solar; assets sold in a 2014 receivership after the Hattiesburg plant failed

storify.note: acq. by Livefyre, 2013, and on to Adobe in 2016; the service closed in 2018

stripe.note: DISPUTE: recorded acquired, which is wrong — Stripe is private and six other landed bases carry it private at $106.5B-$159B. The acquired status came from a deterministic pre-fill, not from evidence. Status corrected to private here; the mark must be web-cited in the A/B pass and aligned to the freshest cross-investor as-of. Khosla is not an early Stripe investor — its own card says Growth and its listing years start 2014, so the entry is a late round.

sunborne-energy.note: Indian solar thermal developer with a US holding entity; no trace after the 2012 filings

sword-health.note: Khosla led the round with Founders Fund, Green Innovations, Lachy Groom, Vesalius Biocapital and Faber Ventures

synchron.note: endovascular brain-computer interface, founded 2012; the firm's first filing is the 2021 round, so the entry is late. Moved HQ from Campbell CA to New York.

tightdb.note: TightDB renamed Realm in 2014; acq. by MongoDB, 2019, ~$39M

topanga.note: Topanga Technologies, plasma lighting; no trace after the 2011 filings and the one-word name needs the recognition check

toytalk.note: ToyTalk renamed PullString in 2016; acq. by Apple, 2019

tracevector.note: no trace after the 2013 filings; the Form D address is Forest Hills, a Queens neighbourhood, recorded as New York per the municipality rule

transonic-combustion.note: supercritical fuel injection; ceased operations 2013 after failing to raise

two-pore-guys-inc.note: renamed Ontera, solid-state nanopore detection; no financing trace after the 2018 filings

ukko.note: protein engineering for allergens and gluten; incorporated 2016, the firm's own invest year is 2017

ultima-genomics.note: $100 genome sequencing; founded 2016 and in stealth until the $600M raise announced May 2022. The firm's own card says Seed, consistent with a stealth-era entry. Large round, no cited valuation — queued for the A/B pass.

unreal-brands.note: UNREAL, no-additive confectionery; no financing trace after the 2013 filings

upstart.note: NASDAQ: UPST, founded 2012; Khosla was in the early rounds but the round name is not established

varda.note: in-space pharmaceutical manufacturing, incorporated 2020; the firm's own invest year is 2021 and the first filing is the 2021 round, so the entry is at the seed. Delian Asparouhov co-founded Varda and was a Khosla principal before Founders Fund — the D3 pattern; Khosla's own listing is what makes this a member. Recent frontier row — queued for the A/B pass.

varentec.note: acq. by Sentient Energy, 2020 — grid edge voltage control

velo3d.note: metal additive manufacturing; founded 2014 by Benny Buller, a Khosla partner who left to start it, and the firm's own invest year is 2014, so the entry is the founding round. Calibration-trap row: the founder being on the roster does not make it a personal position.

verifica-bg.note: one $0.8M filing in 2010 and no later trace

view-glass.note: View Inc, electrochromic glass; founded as Soladigm in 2007, public by SPAC 2021, Chapter 11 in 2024 and bought by Cantor Fitzgerald out of it. The soladigm row is the same company — flagged for identity-merges.json.

viome-inc.note: microbiome testing and nutrition; ~$170M raised, no unicorn mark

vivodyne.note: lab-grown human tissue for drug testing, incorporated 2020; Khosla led the 2023 seed. The Form D address is the Brisbane CA lab; the company is Philadelphia-headquartered.

waabi.note: autonomous trucking, Toronto; Sven Strohband of Khosla led the $83.5M Series A in 2021. Later rounds are large with no cited valuation — queued for the A/B pass.

weatherbill.note: WeatherBill renamed The Climate Corporation in 2011; acq. by Monsanto, 2013, ~$930M. The climate-corp row is the same company — flagged for identity-merges.json.

xobni.note: acq. by Yahoo, 2013, ~$60M — email contact management
